name: multermate
description: A powerful and flexible file upload utility built on top of Multer with TypeScript support, comprehensive file type handling, custom error classes, and universal JavaScript module compatibility

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm && npm run build:types && npm run build:entries
scripts.build:esm: tsc --module ES2020 --outDir dist/esm --target ES2020 && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'module' }, null, 2))"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['dist', 'types'].forEach(dir => { try { fs.rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true}); } catch(e){} })"

author: Wasim Zaman
